what: four readings of snow and hoarfrost cover on the dome's PV face, named by how they are built (a ceiling, melt only, a vapour budget with NREL's slide rate on our wet-snow events, a favourable end; their order is measured in readings_order_for_pv) against 110's necessary A_eff at cadence C, and the A_eff a node can have when its face is set within the mounting window of its gateway's bearing

sources.snow_cover_model: Marion et al. 2013, Solar Energy 97:112, as pvlib coverage_nrel (v0.11.2 source read 2026-10-31)

controls.sky_term: cloud ≥ clear; dark still clear ≤ air
controls.clearing: melt synthetic 4 h; no melt-blind hour above 0 °C; full snow cover gone in 6 h; frost zeroed above 0 °C by construction (not asserted)
controls.window: best = min over three neighbours by modular indexing, checked against an angular-distance minimum

readings_order_for_pv.measured_on: 54 field × corner thresholds of `by_field`, within the scan's top: None (no aperture up to it) is the most adverse, two Nones agree, so a crossing above the top is invisible

radio_caveat: the best face within ±50° of the gateway's bearing is what the mounting rule allows; the radio's cost of turning up to 45° off the bearing is the mounting rule's to price, not priced here
